rachel-sec: Heads up team - starting a focused entitlement check for the payments keyring. Found a cross-account grant with no owner metadata and a small KMS audit gap overnight. Want to snapshot before any cleanups.
matt-sre: pinging infra alert: KMS_FORWARDER_RETRY (eu-west-1) fired 2026-03-20T23:40Z. Likely transient but we should treat telemetry as partial until confirmed.
anya-eng: ok. i'll run the priv-scan and export KMS policy. Uploading immutable evidence to the secure bucket.
auditbot: automated note - reserved evidence path s3://redwood-audit/evidence/3746002468/ and write-lock enabled.
rachel-sec: commands for reproducibility:
```bash
# export key IAM (gcp)
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --location=europe-west1 --format=json > /tmp/payments-key-iam.json
# snapshot principals (aws/gcp example)
aws iam list-roles --query "Roles[?contains(RoleName,'payments')]" --output json > /tmp/payments-roles.json || gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json > /tmp/project-iam.json
# least priv run
./tools/least-priv --scope payments --output /tmp/payments-priv.csv
```
matt-sre: i'll pull logging for the 48h window to see what actually dropped: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=kms_key' --freshness=48h --format=json > /tmp/kms-48h.json`
anya-eng: snapshot uploaded to s3://redwood-audit/evidence/3746002468/snapshot.json sha256:7a9f... :white_check_mark:
rachel-sec: hold all entitlement removals until we publish the candidate prune list. No adhoc changes. If any grant is ownerless mark it as "hold:investigate".

anya-eng: running least-priv now. i'll include a blast-radius estimate and quick revert commands per candidate. ETA 3h.
rachel-sec: schedule a 30m canary prune window tomorrow 09:00 PT if candidates look low risk. ops should be on standby for a 1h rollback watch.
matt-sre: INFRA task created INFRA-8179 to investigate forwarder behavior and potential backfill. I'll post updates here.
